title: PEACE FOR YOUR MIDDAY WORK
PRAYER ON ISAIAH 26:12
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: sunlit wooden desk with notebook open under midday window light
bright midday sunlight streaming through window onto quiet room
high sun over calm lake surrounded by quiet mountains
sunbeams shining through green leaves on peaceful desk surface
sunlit mountain path under bright clear sky at noon
warm sunlight on open journal beside cup of coffee
tranquil sunny horizon over calm water at midday

scenes.a: Your unfinished work is crowding your mind today.
You have strived through the morning hours, carrying every single task as though it rested entirely on your own strength.
Hear the quiet promise of Isaiah 26 verse 12: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
scenes.sub: THOU WILT ORDAIN PEACE FOR US

scenes.a: Lord, we lay down our self-reliance in this middle hour of the day.
Ordain peace over the labor of our hands, knowing that every true accomplishment is wrought by You.
Quiet our restless thoughts and grant us steady focus for what lies ahead.
Amen. Receive His peace when your unfinished work is crowding your mind today.
